text:
Type: rectangular wall mirror with corner clips
Use: hanging over a sink, a dresser or a console; bathroom, hallway, bedroom
Style: minimalist, Scandinavian, contemporary
Materials: mirror glass, white plastic corner holders
Colors: silver reflection, white corners
Shape: horizontal rectangle with a bare flat edge and four small white corner clips, flat to the wall, simple and light
Feel: clean, simple, bright, practical
Goes with: white walls, white or light wood cabinets, chrome fixtures; Scandinavian or minimalist bathrooms and hallways

product.name: ENUDDEN
product.description: The mirror comes with safety film on the back, which reduces the risk of injury if the glass is broken.
